A.why: You counted only the 3-or-more-syllable Latin words, $\frac{38}{200}$. "At least 2" includes words with exactly 2 syllables too.

C.why: You added the 2-syllable and 3-or-more-syllable column totals, $\frac{78 + 66}{200}$. That counts words of every origin, but the question asks only about Latin words.

D.why: You divided the right count by the Latin row total, $\frac{72}{80}$. That answers "given that the word is Latin," but the word is chosen from all 200.
